Hi Samir —

Welcome, and thanks for the details. Happy to get Lumenix set up. For our vendor master we require the following to complete the record and route POs/invoices correctly:

Required items (please return as PDF or through the form attached):
- Completed vendor intake form (attached: redwood_vendor_intake.pdf)
- Legal name and DBA (if different)
- Tax form: W-9 (or W-8 if non-US)
- Remittance / bank wiring instructions (bank name, account number, ACH routing or SWIFT/IBAN)
- Invoice contact (name, email, phone) and PO contact (if different)
- Registered/legal address + mailing address for checks (if applicable)
- Primary point of contact for contract signing and for procurement questions

Optional but helpful:
- Certificate of insurance (if applicable to delivery/engagement)
- Any vendor sub-IDs you use for multi-entity billing

Turnaround target: if you can return the completed intake + W-9 and wiring info by EOD tomorrow (Oct 20), Procurement/AP will create the master record and issue a test PO. Once created, we'll share the vendor ID and the PO contact routing.

I've CC'd Marissa from Procurement to help verify the PO routing and Karthik for vendor policy questions.

Thanks —
